answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 6 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the meadow count is verified against the dawn text itself, the sonnet audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 194 aliases hence means producing 194 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 3 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
